description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing a Button Hotplug driver, handling button events and generating uevents.

methods.name: bh_event_add_var
methods.description: Adds a variable string to the event skb buffer.

methods.name: button_hotplug_fill_event
methods.description: Fills event with standard environment variables.

methods.name: button_hotplug_work
methods.description: Performs the work of sending the uevent.

methods.name: button_hotplug_create_event
methods.description: Creates and schedules a button event.

methods.name: button_get_index
methods.description: Returns index of button code in button_map.

methods.name: __init
methods.description: Initializes the button hotplug driver module.

methods.name: __exit
methods.description: Cleans up the driver module on exit.
